raw.details:
About the Hackathon

The Code Vibes proudly presents THE CODE VIBES HACKATHON 1.0, an online national-level hackathon designed to bring together students, developers, innovators, and problem-solvers from across India.

The hackathon provides a platform to transform creative ideas into innovative technology solutions that address real-world challenges. Participants will collaborate, develop prototypes, showcase their technical skills, and compete for exciting prizes and recognition.

Hackathon Tracks

Participants can build projects under the following domains:

  1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
  2. Web Development
  3. App Development
  4. Cybersecurity
  5. Open Innovation

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students from colleges and universities across India.
  • Developers, beginners, innovators, and technology enthusiasts are welcome.
  • Participants can register individually or in teams.
  • Team size: 1–3 members.
  • Inter-college teams are allowed.
  • Inter-specialization and interdisciplinary teams are allowed.
  • Participants from different academic backgrounds can collaborate.
  • No specific programming language or technology stack is mandatory.

Hackathon Format

The hackathon will be conducted online in the following stages:

Round 1: Registration & Idea Submission
Participants must register and submit their project idea, problem statement, proposed solution, and technology stack.

Round 2: Development & Prototype Building
Shortlisted or registered teams will work on developing their solutions and building a functional prototype.

Round 3: Final Project Submission
Teams must submit their project source code, GitHub repository, project presentation, and demo video.

Round 4: Evaluation & Results
Projects will be evaluated by the judging panel based on innovation, technical implementation, impact, usability, and presentation.

Problem Statements

Participants may select a problem statement from the announced tracks or propose an original idea under Open Innovation.

Suggested areas include:

  • AI-powered student learning and productivity tools
  • Smart campus and education solutions
  • Cybersecurity awareness and threat detection
  • Healthcare and social impact technology
  • Sustainable development and smart agriculture
  • Automation and intelligent web or mobile applications

Rules & Guidelines

  1. All projects must be original and developed by the participating team.
  2. Existing projects are allowed only if significant new features or improvements are added during the hackathon.
  3. Open-source libraries, frameworks, APIs, and AI tools are permitted.
  4. Plagiarism, copied submissions, and fraudulent information may result in disqualification.
  5. Each team must submit a working prototype or demonstrable solution.
  6. Teams must provide a project description, source code repository, presentation, and demo video.
  7. All team members must be listed during registration.
  8. A participant can be part of only one team.
  9. Teams must adhere to the submission deadline.
  10. The organizers reserve the right to disqualify teams violating the rules.
  11. Judges' decisions will be final.
  12. Participants must maintain professional and ethical conduct throughout the event.

Submission Requirements

Each team must submit:

  • Project title and description
  • Problem statement and proposed solution
  • GitHub repository link
  • Project presentation (PPT/PDF)
  • Demo video or working prototype link
  • Technology stack used
  • Team member details

Judging Criteria

  • Innovation & Creativity: 25%
  • Technical Implement
